subject: Close cadence derailment triage + MAP retargeting request
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: David Reynolds <david.reynolds@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close cadence derailment triage + MAP retargeting request

David —

Thanks for the sync earlier this morning. Per our call I pulled the current MAP and acceptance plan into the attached spreadsheet (Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx) and flagged the three items that are driving the slip:

- Network testing (third-party tester availability) — currently blocking final load tests.
- Legal redlines on data residency Appendix B — procurement asked for extra review.
- Integration E2E test flake around SSO session refresh on Stage.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Retarget go-live windows (two-week shift) so we preserve the planned phased acceptance for critical paths rather than compressing them.
2) Kick a targeted canary for non-auth traffic on Week 1 of the retarget to protect latency SLOs.
3) Procurement — we will prepare an amendment to the MPA with the revised milestone dates and a one-time credit proposal to offset the schedule impact.

Can you confirm whether Helix can:
- Confirm whether the third-party tester can run the final window on the week of June 17 (we proposed June 17–21 in the spreadsheet), and
- Whether legal can accept our proposed Appendix B language (attached summary) or if they need a deeper redline session this week?

If you’re ok with the retarget, I’ll send a formal MAP v2 and loop in Contracts (Karthik) to draft the amendment.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198
attachments: [Helix_MAP_v1.xlsx, Helix_MAP_v1_summary.pdf]

From: David Reynolds <david.reynolds@helixhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Sosa <elena.sosa@helixhealth.com>, Procurement <procure@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close cadence derailment triage + MAP retargeting request

Tessa —

Thanks for the write-up and the flags. Short answers:
- Tester availability: we can move the final window to the week of June 17 but it will be a compressed window (one full-day test + two validation days). The testing vendor asked for a single confirmation by EOD 6/3.
- Legal: Appendix B needs one more pass. They asked for a redline call (30 min) to walk through data residency controls — Elena can take that with your contracts lead.

On the commercial side, the team is open to a small credit if you can keep the full phased acceptance intact and provide a firm go-live cadence. Procurement (cc) will want the amendment text and the credit amount spelled out.

Two asks from our side:
1) Does Redwood have a documented contingency for the SSO flake (we need a mitigation that doesn’t delay Stage acceptance)?
2) Can you commit to priority engineering support during the canary weeks?

I’ll aim to get procurement’s formal stance by tomorrow afternoon.

—David
David Reynolds
Director, Platform Integrations | Helix Health
phone: +1 617 555 0123

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: David Reynolds <david.reynolds@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Elena Sosa <elena.sosa@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 12:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close cadence derailment triage + MAP retargeting request

David / Elena —

Appreciate the quick reply. Short responses to your asks and a suggested path forward:

- SSO flake mitigation: Engineering proposes a rollback-safe toggle for session refresh (feature flag) that lets us validate auth behavior without blocking Stage acceptance. We’ll run the toggle-backed canary for 48 hours and fall back if we see regressions — that avoids a full rollback and preserves the phased plan. (Karthik — can you confirm capacity for the toggle and triage team?)
- Priority support: Redwood will allocate a designated on-call engineer for the canary windows and a pre-scheduled 2x30min daily triage slot for the integration team.

Attached is a draft MAP v2 (Helix_MAP_v2_proposed.xlsx) that:
- shifts the final go-live milestone by 14 days,
- breaks phased acceptance into Week A (inbound traffic) and Week B (full traffic), and
- includes a proposed one-time credit of 5% applied to the first invoice if the final go-live slips beyond the new window.

Next steps:
- If you confirm tester availability by EOD 6/3 and legal gives us the redline call slot, I’ll route the amendment to Contracts and open a HubSpot action with the DocuSign envelope (link below).

DocuSign draft (internal): https://docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=abc-123-helix
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HLX-4721

Can you reply with a single-line ack (tester confirmed / legal slot accepted) so I can progress amends and schedule the canary support?

Thanks — talk soon.

Tessa Morgan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
attachments: [Helix_MAP_v2_proposed.xlsx]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: Helix — approve MAP v2 and discretionary credit? (need quick sign-off)

Markus / Karthik / Grace —

Looping you in as Helix has signaled the need for:
- a 14-day retarget (MAP v2 attached), and
- procurement expects a commercial amendment with a one-time 5% credit tied to further slip.

Why I’m escalating:
- The MAP preserves phased acceptance and keeps core SLO acceptance windows intact via the feature-flag canary approach (avoids a full rollback).
- Procurement will withhold a final signature unless they see the amendment plus a clear operational contingency (we have the on-call commitment).

Request:
1) Approve the 5% discretionary credit on this deal if Helix confirms tester availability by EOD 6/3.
2) Approve priority engineering allocation during the canary windows (we need to lock 2 FTE-days of triage support).

Quoted thread below for context. If you approve, I’ll instruct Contracts to push the amendment into DocuSign and ask Legal to join the redline call with Elena.
